_why: W17-DENSITY-B2-B3, 2026-09-04. Band 3's authored findables -- the addendum's (docs/FINISH_THE_MEADOWS_ADDENDUM_2026-09-04.md section B/C) regional batch for The River Lock, read by scripts/world/band_pickups.gd and stood up through item_cache_pickup.gd. The critical path carries two Good (the haulage wreck at the seam, the restored crossing's far landing) and its recovery; side routes carry Good; the band's named places -- the lockwater overlook, the springhead and its Elder Brooktail, the relay approach loop, the gated near-bank river walk's dead end, the Galecrest alpha, the far-east orb pocket -- carry Great; the two Rare sit on the two rare wilds (Stormtrail on the relay's tether hardware in rain, Riftfrill's still pool at night). GATE3_ENCOUNTER_CONTRACTS P-3.1 is kept: nothing that heals is authored between Hess at (241,3680) and the restored crossing -- every potion and revive in this file is met BEFORE the checkpoint barricade or AFTER the crossing, so the gauntlet's attrition is real and the camp at (210,3700) stays the band's only rest. Every `id` is the once-flag (`cache:<id>`) and is unique across the chapter. Positions are world [x, z]; y is asked of the ground (D09). ALL TUNABLE, but move a placement and its `why` together.

pickups.why: beside the tether haulage wreck at (-71,3250) on the spine: the band opens on faction evidence, and the sweet spilled from the sled is the one candy the critical path hands over before the river
the Stonewater Reach's west shelf (landmark centre (-120,3420) r70) above the night duskhush at (-165,3430): off the spine bend at (-160,3420), where the gorge first opens
at the Reach's loose stone (-180,3460): a Stamina Shroom in the shade of the shelf, the defence a player wants before the relay's officer and captain
at the lockwater overlook (props cluster 3006 at (-130,3452)), the landmark where the gorge is read from above, beside the greater-orb crate: a named place pays Great
at the springhead (props 3007 at (5,3558)) on the Elder Brooktail's ground (8,3560) r12: the band's first named optional encounter, and a harder one, pays Great
in the bramblebun meadow between the spring and the road (bramblebun at (-19,3542), mudsnout at (12,3581)): ordinary side ground, a Good
on the spine past the spring, under the pipwing at (87,3639), well before the checkpoint: the first recovery of the relay approach, met before Hess, never between him and the crossing (P-3.1)
at the camp clearing's edge (clearing (210,3700) r11, bed at (212,3701)): the band's only rest, the last safe ground before the gauntlet, and a small reason to walk into it rather than past it
at the camp before the checkpoint: the relay is four fights in a row and P-3.1 forbids any heal past Hess, so the revive the gauntlet will cost is handed over here, at the last camp before it
on the camp clearing's road side by the attack-tonic crate at (200,3688): a Wild Shroom for the officer and captain waiting up the road
on the spine just short of the checkpoint barricade (238,3680) and Hess: the large potion is the last recovery before the relay, deliberately in front of the barricade, not behind it
on the relay approach loop's high point (loop point (340,3810)), where the compound is seen from its own picket line: the band's authored detour pays Great
beside the tether machinery Stormtrail (spawns order 3100, (318,3830) r12, rain only) stands on: the band's rare alpha on Team Tether hardware, only met in rain, guards a Rare
on the loop's south leg (loop point (230,3940)) by the trailpup at (313,3878) and the burrowback at (246,3959): the walk back to the road is paid once more
in the Old Mill's yard (props 3004 at (-140,4217)) at the Long Water: the mill is the story's crossing and a Good in its yard says the yard was worked
at Riftfrill's still pool (spawns order 3101, (-176,4098) r8, night only): the band's rare night wild, on the far side of the Long Water, pays Rare to the player who walks the bank after dark
at the gated near-bank river walk's dead end (loop point (-100,4270)), where the far side is seen and cannot be reached yet: a dead end the player chose to walk pays Great instead of nothing

on the far landing past the restored crossing, before the galecrest ambush at (-152,4235) and Oreth in the draw (P-3.3's three beats in 150m): recovery met before the far-bank attrition, after the crossing so P-3.1 still holds
the restored crossing's far landing: the critical path's one Good on the far bank, so crossing the river is felt as arriving somewhere rather than only as a gate opening
behind Oreth's Riverwatch post at (-100,4350) in the draw, past his bench: the player who walks round the captain rather than only fighting him finds the draw is a place
on the Galecrest alpha's ground ((152,4552) r12, spawns order 3103) east of the spine: the band's last temptation and an aggressive alpha; a harder optional fight pays Great
at the north-bank ironwood cut (nodes at (71-86,4494-4506), props 3008): the band's only ironwood, and a Good in the sawdust for the player who fells it
under the felled round at the ironwood cut: a Speed Shroom for the long open climb into Band 4

with the orb cache at (515,4225), the band's deepest side pocket, 350m east of the spine on the east bank: the deepest optional walk in the band pays Great, and the galecrest pair guarding it makes it a choice
